derivation: from a derivative of G1364 (δίς) and G4714 (στάσις);

occurrences.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
